-기가.label: Nominalizer + subject marker
-기가.note: Bundled nominalization and particle; separate analyses may expose the components.

-기는.label: Denial / nominalizer + topic
-기는.note: Includes both an independent ending and a nominalization + particle reading.

-기도.label: Nominalizer + also
-기도.note: Bundled nominalization and particle; separate analyses may expose the components.

-기로.label: Reason / concession / nominalizer + 로
-기로.note: Includes both an independent ending and a nominalization + particle reading.

-기를.label: Nominalizer + object marker
-기를.note: Bundled nominalization and particle; separate analyses may expose the components.

-기만.label: Nominalizer + only
-기만.note: Bundled nominalization and particle; separate analyses may expose the components.

-기보다.label: Nominalizer + comparison
-기보다.note: Bundled nominalization and particle; separate analyses may expose the components.

-는가요.label: Question / wondering (polite)
-는가요.note: Bundled ending + particle; source links describe the components.

-는데다가.label: In addition
-는데다가.note: Joined-input representation of -는 데다가; the dictionary expression includes a space.

-다니.label: Surprise / repeated question
-다니.note: Surprise permits bare verbs as well as adjectives; the separate fact-question and quotation homonyms retain their source notes. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-란.label: Quoted fact (noun-modifying)
-란.note: Shortened -라고 하는, kept as one component. Used after a copula, retrospective 더 or scoped conjectural (으)리; no implicit reporting verb is inserted.

-시-.label: Subject honorific
-시-.note: Canonical form covers the source-listed short/full allomorphs. A vowel-final nominal may have an omitted copula before the short form; the intended honorific referent and speech act remain contextual.

-어서는.label: Sequence / reason + topic
-어서는.note: Bundled ending + particle; source links describe the components.

-어서도.label: Sequence / reason + also
-어서도.note: Bundled ending + particle; source links describe the components.

-어야죠.label: Determination / obligation (polite)
-어야죠.note: Contracted -어야지요; -죠 is the shortened form of -지요.

-으나마.label: Although limited
-으나마.note: Predicate ending, distinct from the nominal/adverbial particle (이)나마.

-으니.label: Reason / premise / question
-으니.note: Canonical form covers the short allomorph after a vowel or ㄹ boundary, including a represented copula. Source entries distinguish short and full attachment; labels do not select a contextual sense.

-으니까.label: Reason / premise
-으니까.note: Canonical form covers the short allomorph after a vowel or ㄹ boundary, including a represented copula. Source entries distinguish short and full attachment; labels do not select a contextual sense.

-으란.label: Quoted command (noun-modifying)
-으란.note: Shortened -(으)라고 하는. The source also illustrates state-directed commands; contextual mood and lexical classes are not selected here.

-으리-.label: Conjecture / intention
-으리-.note: Prefinal representation scoped to factual -라/-라서/-라고/-라면 and quoted -란. Existing -(으)리라 and -(으)리라고 bundled endings remain alternatives.

-으리라고.label: Reported intention / expectation
-으리라고.note: Bundled expression; context distinguishes resolve from expectation. No implicit reporting verb is inserted.

-으세요.label: Polite statement / question / request
-으세요.note: Canonical form covers the source-listed short/full allomorphs. A vowel-final nominal may have an omitted copula before the short form; the intended honorific referent and speech act remain contextual.

-은가요.label: Question / wondering (polite)
-은가요.note: Bundled ending + particle; source links describe the components.

-은데다가.label: In addition
-은데다가.note: Joined-input representation of -은 데다가; the dictionary expression includes a space.

-자면.label: If intending / if proposing
-자면.note: Intention ending or shortened proposal quotation (-자고 하면); context distinguishes the senses. No implicit 하다 is inserted.

-지만요.label: But / although (polite)
-지만요.note: Bundled ending + particle; source links describe the components.

나마.label: At least / even if limited
나마.note: Particle after a nominal or adverbial phrase; distinct from the predicate ending -(으)나마.

는커녕.label: Far from / let alone
는커녕.note: The contracted ㄴ커녕 is normalized to 는커녕; the particle remains one component.

란.label: As for / defining
란.note: Definition/topic particle after an open nominal; separate from quoted copula + -란.

만큼.label: As much as / to the extent

이나마.label: At least / even if limited
이나마.note: Particle after a nominal or adverbial phrase; distinct from copula + ending -(으)나마.

이란.label: As for / defining
이란.note: Definition/topic particle after a consonant-final nominal; separate from copula + -란.

-어야겠-.label: Intention / necessity
-어야겠-.note: Bundled -아/어/여야겠- before a final ending. The vowel form is normalized; no implicit 하다 lemma or contextual interpretation is inserted.

-더라는.label: Quoted experience (noun-modifying)
-더라는.note: Bundled contraction of -더라고 하는. Reports another person’s experience while modifying a following noun; no implicit 하다 lemma is inserted.

-는답니다.label: Polite information / report
-는답니다.note: Canonical -는답니다 includes attached -ㄴ답니다 after vowels or ㄹ; informative and reported-speech homonyms share the form.

-답니다.label: Polite information / report
-답니다.note: Informative ending or shortened -다고 합니다; this component does not choose a contextual sense or insert 하다.

-랍니다.label: Polite information / report
-랍니다.note: Copular or factual-prefinal reading. The command homonym is represented separately by canonical -으랍니다; the source entry contains both senses.

-으랍니다.label: Reported command / request
-으랍니다.note: Shortened -(으)라고 합니다; canonical 으랍니다 includes vowel/ㄹ 랩니다. No implicit 하다 is inserted.

-요.label: And / in contrast (copula)
-요.note: Enumerative connective after 이다/아니다, distinct from polite particle 요 and terminal -오. Vowel-final nominals may omit 이.

-기에.label: Reason / basis
-기에.note: Causal connective, distinct from nominalizing -기 plus particle 에. Source-listed honorific, past and modal attachment.

-길래.label: Reason / basis
-길래.note: Primarily spoken causal connective; source-listed honorific and past attachment. Contextual interpretation is not selected.

-는다거나.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-는다거나.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-다거나.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-다거나.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-라거나.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-라거나.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-으라거나.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-으라거나.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-자거나.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-자거나.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-는다든가.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-는다든가.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-다든가.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-다든가.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

-라든가.label: Reported alternatives / examples
-라든가.note: Source-listed grammar expression represented as one component. No implicit 하다 lemma is inserted. Copular, declarative, command and proposal readings retain separate attachment rules.

이라든가.label: Enumerative examples
이라든가.note: Consonant-final nominal particle, separate from copula + -라든가.

라든가.label: Enumerative examples
라든가.note: Vowel-final related form; the dictionary pane links the consonant-form entry. See NIKL 2017 curriculum p. 463 for the related-form inventory. Distinct from ending -라든가.

이라든지.label: Enumerative examples
이라든지.note: Consonant-final nominal particle; this component does not insert a copula.

라든지.label: Enumerative examples
라든지.note: Vowel-final nominal or adverbial particle; separate from copular/quoted expression -라든지.

든가.label: Any choice
든가.note: Particle after a vowel-final nominal/adverbial phrase or a licensed final ending; distinct from ending -든가.

이든가.label: Any choice
이든가.note: Consonant-final related form; the pane links 든가 because the pinned dictionary lacks 이든가. NIKL grammar-expression study, stage 3, section 3.1.12 documents this allomorph.

-든가.label: Choice / alternative
-든가.note: Literal connective ending, distinct from particle 든가 and the bundled quoted alternatives. Honorific and past prefinals are supported.

에다.label: Location / addition
에다.note: Bundled particle; a separately licensed component reading may also be available. Context selects location, addition, direction, means or recipient sense.

에다가.label: Location / addition
에다가.note: Bundled particle; a separately licensed component reading may also be available. Context selects location, addition, direction, means or recipient sense.

에게다.label: Emphatic recipient
에게다.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

에게다가.label: Emphatic recipient
에게다가.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

한테다.label: Emphatic recipient
한테다.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

한테다가.label: Emphatic recipient
한테다가.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

로다가.label: Emphatic direction / means
로다가.note: Bundled particle; a separately licensed component reading may also be available. Context selects location, addition, direction, means or recipient sense.

으로다가.label: Emphatic direction / means
으로다가.note: Bundled particle; a separately licensed component reading may also be available. Context selects location, addition, direction, means or recipient sense.

보고.label: Recipient / addressee
보고.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

더러.label: Recipient / addressee
더러.note: Recipient reading requires an appropriate referent, typically a person or animate/personified entity. A dictionary match does not establish that use in this sentence.

다.label: Enumeration / emphasis
다.note: Enumerative 다 follows a vowel-final nominal; emphatic 다 follows a reviewed adverbial base. Identical component paths retain both source readings; context selects their use.

다가.label: Adverbial emphasis
다가.note: Emphatic particle after a reviewed case phrase or deictic location/direction word. Distinct from predicate endings and the separate enumerative 다 particle.

이다.label: Enumeration
이다.note: Enumerative particle after a consonant-final nominal. Distinct from the copula 이다; a surrounding list is not inferred from this token.

-고서.label: After / reason / condition
-고서.note: Literal verb connector; the 아니다 conditional use remains. Context chooses sequence, reason, condition or contrast.

-어서야.label: Only after / emphatic reason
-어서야.note: Canonical vowel-boundary ending covers 아/어/여 allomorphs. The separate 어서 + emphatic 야 path is also retained.

-다네.label: Information / report
-다네.note: Informative ending and shortened -다고 하네 share this form; sense selection and an implicit 하다 are not inferred.

-는다네.label: Information / report
-는다네.note: Canonical 는다네 includes attached ㄴ다네 after vowels or ㄹ; preserve informative and reported-speech homonyms.

-라네.label: Copular / factual report
-라네.note: Copular or factual-prefinal reading; the reported-command homonym is represented separately as 으라네.

-으라네.label: Reported command / request
-으라네.note: Shortened -(으)라고 하네; the 라네 source also contains a distinct copular/factual sense.

-다는데.label: Report / background
-다는데.note: Shortened -다고 하는데, used as background or an indirect statement; represented as one component without an implicit 하다.

-는다는데.label: Report / background
-는다는데.note: Canonical 는다는데 includes attached ㄴ다는데 after vowels or ㄹ; shortened reported speech.

-라는데.label: Copular / factual background
-라는데.note: Copular/factual reading of shortened -라고 하는데; the command reading uses canonical 으라는데.

-으라는데.label: Reported command / background
-으라는데.note: Shortened -(으)라고 하는데; the 라는데 source also contains a distinct copular/factual sense.

-더라네.label: Retrospective report
-더라네.note: Bundled -더라고 하네; retained alongside the split retrospective 더 + 라네 reading.

-더라는데.label: Retrospective report / background
-더라는데.note: Bundled -더라고 하는데; retained alongside the split retrospective 더 + 라는데 reading.

-으되.label: Contrast / qualification / quotation
-으되.note: Canonical 으되 includes literal 되; selection follows lexical/prefinal notes rather than a general consonant/vowel rule. Contextual sense is not selected.

치고.label: Generalization / exception
치고.note: Attaches to a nominal. The following context determines the sense; bundled and component alternatives may coexist.

치고는.label: Against expectations
치고는.note: Attaches to a nominal. The following context determines the sense; bundled and component alternatives may coexist.

치고서.label: Emphatic generalization / exception
치고서.note: Attaches to a nominal. The following context determines the sense; bundled and component alternatives may coexist.

토록.label: Throughout / to the extent
토록.note: This label is the particle reading. Whole lexical words and bound-noun/adverb homonyms remain separate; contextual sense is not selected.

마냥.label: Like / as if
마냥.note: This label is the particle reading. Whole lexical words and bound-noun/adverb homonyms remain separate; contextual sense is not selected.

만치.label: As much as / limited to
만치.note: This label is the particle reading. Whole lexical words and bound-noun/adverb homonyms remain separate; contextual sense is not selected.

-쯤.label: About / approximately
-쯤.note: Approximate amount or degree after a noun or noun phrase. Whole lexical readings remain separate; this is a suffix, not a particle.

-다며.label: Report / confirmation
-다며.note: Adjective or licensed prefinal; preserve the expression and confirmation-ending homonyms. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-는다며.label: Report / confirmation
-는다며.note: Present verbal allomorphs: 는다 after non-ㄹ consonants, attached ㄴ다 after vowels/ㄹ or honorific 시. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-라며.label: Copular / factual report
-라며.note: Copular or factual-prefinal reading; the command reading is represented separately as 으라. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-으라며.label: Reported command / confirmation
-으라며.note: Command/request allomorphs; the short 라 source also contains a copular/factual sense. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-더라며.label: Retrospective report
-더라며.note: Bundled retrospective report; preserve the separate 더 + 라 reading as well. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-자며.label: Reported proposal / confirmation
-자며.note: Proposal quotation or confirmation; no implicit reporting verb is inserted. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-냐며.label: Reported question
-냐며.note: Shortened quoted question; separate from commands and proposals. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-느냐며.label: Reported question
-느냐며.note: Verbal/existential question or licensed prefinal, retaining the source attachment classes. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-으냐며.label: Reported question
-으냐며.note: Adjectival (으)냐 allomorphs. The short 냐 source also permits other predicate classes; those readings remain separate. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-다면서.label: Report / confirmation
-다면서.note: Adjective or licensed prefinal; preserve the expression and confirmation-ending homonyms. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-는다면서.label: Report / confirmation
-는다면서.note: Present verbal allomorphs: 는다 after non-ㄹ consonants, attached ㄴ다 after vowels/ㄹ or honorific 시. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-라면서.label: Copular / factual report
-라면서.note: Copular or factual-prefinal reading; the command reading is represented separately as 으라. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-으라면서.label: Reported command / confirmation
-으라면서.note: Command/request allomorphs; the short 라 source also contains a copular/factual sense. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-더라면서.label: Retrospective report
-더라면서.note: Bundled retrospective report; preserve the separate 더 + 라 reading as well. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-자면서.label: Reported proposal / confirmation
-자면서.note: Proposal quotation or confirmation; no implicit reporting verb is inserted. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-냐면서.label: Reported question
-냐면서.note: Shortened quoted question; separate from commands and proposals. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-느냐면서.label: Reported question
-느냐면서.note: Verbal/existential question or licensed prefinal, retaining the source attachment classes. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-으냐면서.label: Reported question
-으냐면서.note: Adjectival (으)냐 allomorphs. The short 냐 source also permits other predicate classes; those readings remain separate. The contraction is represented as one grammatical component; context selects its sense.

-는다니.label: Present report / surprise
-는다니.note: Present verbs: 는다니 after non-ㄹ consonants, attached ㄴ다니 after vowels/ㄹ or honorific 시. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-라니.label: Copular / factual report
-라니.note: Factual/copular reading, including licensed 시/더/으리. Command readings are represented separately as 으라니. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-으라니.label: Reported command / surprise
-으라니.note: Command/request allomorphs. Only the short 라니 expression homonyms contain command senses. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-더라니.label: Retrospective report
-더라니.note: Bundled retrospective report; preserve the separate 더 + 라니 analysis. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-자니.label: Reported proposal
-자니.note: Bare verbal proposal quotation, surprise or reported ground. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-냐니.label: Reported question
-냐니.note: Generic shortened question quotation; its response and emotional senses remain source homonyms. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-느냐니.label: Reported question
-느냐니.note: Verbal/existential question or licensed honorific, past or modal prefinal. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.

-으냐니.label: Reported question
-으냐니.note: Bare adjective (으)냐 allomorph. The short 냐니 entry also has generic question readings, represented separately. This component does not insert an implicit reporting verb or select a contextual sense. Polite 요 can mark a surprise reading without licensing every homonymous sense.
